definition.opposing_zone: nearest unbroken 1H/4H supply for LONG or demand for SHORT, frozen at entry using exact location_context zone detector
definition.touch: price reaches near edge of frozen opposing zone
definition.reject: after touch, first decisive 5m close returns to entry side of near edge
definition.accept: after touch, first decisive 5m close closes through far edge of zone
definition.hold2: bar immediately after acceptance also closes beyond far edge
definition.window: entry through canonical trade exit only
